substitutions.pattern: A skill counts as used when the transcript shows a `Read` of its `SKILL.md` (under `.cursor/skills/`, `~/.cursor/skills/`, or `~/.cursor/plugins/`), a `Task` prompt naming its path, or a tool call (Shell, Grep, MCP, etc.) matching its documented commands.
substitutions.replacement: A skill counts as used when the transcript shows a `Skill` tool call or a user turn that invokes it as `/<name>`, a `Read` of its `SKILL.md` (under project `.claude/skills/`, `${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/skills/`, or `${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/plugins/`) or of any file in the jutsu plugin directory, whose skills, playbooks, and principles load by path, an `Agent` prompt naming its path, or a tool call (Bash, Grep, MCP, etc.) matching its documented commands.
